A.name: Conservative notch-only surrounding native continuation
A.valley_retention: Core normal coordinates weakly guided (0.3 strength); original surface outside support fixed. Core tangent continuation from actual native neighboring positions.
A.normal_progression: Explicit central opposing fold hinge target60deg; all originally acute incident edges retain bounded baseline-relative normal progression.

B.name: Same-hand reference-guided normalized progression
B.soft_depth_slope_prior: Actual reference native triangles sampled in aligned tangent coordinates; affine trend removed, current surrounding dorsal arch trend retained. Small (0.35) soft height attraction. Absolute depth/width not imposed.
B.normal_progression: Central crease target from reference95th-percentile native normal progression with 30deg lower design cap; full local baseline-relative edge constraints retained.

C.reason: Allowed only if A/B structurally feasible but visually insufficient. No mechanical third candidate.

depth_proxy_only: Old fixed-reference quadratic depth is reported solely as a diagnostic, never imposed as hard surface target.
